open_points.subject: issue_contract_version value_schema validation
open_points.text: - issue_contract_version: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] A supported value_schema is a JSON object using only type as one string among null, boolean, integer, number, string, array and object, enum as a non-empty array of distinct scalars, const as one scalar, properties and required for object, additionalProperties true or false only, items as one schema for array, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, minimum and maximum, nested schemas following the same rule; any other keyword is outside the subset; a file port's value_schema is the empty object.
open_points.other_text: - Port fields (exact, no others exist): name: str, direction: PortDirection, value_schema: str, carriage: Carriage, media_type: str | None, cardinality: Cardinality, disclosure_class: DisclosureClass | None
open_points.question: Must value_schema be a str containing serialized JSON, or must the Port model change to permit JSON objects?
